tasks.label: ROS 2: Launch Surveillance Simulation (GUI)
args: export GALLIUM_DRIVER=d3d12 && export MESA_D3D12_DEFAULT_ADAPTER_NAME=NVIDIA && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && if [ ! -f install/setup.bash ]; then colcon build --symlink-install; fi && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch surveillance_sim surveillance_world.launch.py
